Clinical Formula

Salicylic Acid

Salicylic acid is a powerful ingredient that helps keep blemish-prone skin clear by targeting clogged pores. It gently exfoliates, removes dead skin cells, and helps to clear out blocked pores, preventing future breakouts. The result is smoother, clearer skin with fewer blemishes.

Learn More
Zinc PCA
Zinc PCA is a highly effective skincare ingredient that combines the mineral Zinc to regulate sebum production, with the moisturising molecule PCA to help balance and clarify the skin.
 
Learn more: 
Zinc has antibacterial and repairing properties and regulates sebum production, while PCA contributes to natural skin hydration as part of the Skin’s Natural Moisturising Factor.

FAQ

Why does the skin become oily?

Oily skin is mainly caused by hormonal activity or a genetic predisposition, which can stimulate the sebaceous glands to produce excess sebum. This overproduction may lead to enlarged pores and skin that appears shiny and greasy. Excess sebum is also one of the earliest contributors to acne‑prone skin, as it can clog pores and lead to comedones and pimples.

 

Which ingredients help control oily skin?

Salicylic Acid exfoliates the skin and unclogs pores to help remove excess sebum, while Carnitine helps to mattify the skin by supporting oil‑control mechanisms. Zinc PCA supports balanced sebum production while also providing hydration.

Why should I hydrate my oily skin?

Hydration supports the skin barrier by maintaining water balance in the stratum corneum, even in oily skin. A healthy skin barrier is particularly important for acne‑prone skin, as barrier impairment is commonly associated with increased skin sensitivity and discomfort.

What is the best routine to control oily skin?

Cleanse thoroughly to remove daily impurities and excess sebum using a non‑comedogenic cleanser formulated for acne‑prone skin. Follow with a lightweight toner to refine skin texture, then finish with a mattifying product to control oiliness and keep the skin shine‑free throughout the day.

    Lovely, but not mattifying enough
    I really like the texture of this product - it’s gel-like yet still creamy, and it hydrates my skin beautifully. The pale yellow colour was unexpected, and it has a fresh, pleasant scent I can’t quite place. I also enjoy the slight cooling effect when applying it. When it comes to oil control, I did see a small improvement on my forehead and chin, which don’t tend to get too oily anyway. The nose area, though, stayed shiny no matter how much I used. That was a bit disappointing, as I really wanted this to work for me. Still, it’s a lovely product overall and worth a try if you have oily skin. I think Eucerin makes some fantastic skincare, and while this didn’t fully solve my oiliness, I would happily recommend it for its texture, hydration, and overall feel.
